item.title: One Print Style Across Plants

turns.text: Make four square Instagram carousel slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily, in that order. One plant and its name per slide. Keep the exact same sage-green-and-cream linocut style throughout: same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape. Only the plant and name should change. Send separate slides.

item.tests: Tests preservation of a tightly specified visual style and repeated layout across distinct carousel subjects.

answer_sheet.Slide count, order and text: Four separate slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily. Each name is the only copy on its slide.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: Square Instagram carousel slides; 640 × 640 px is fine.
answer_sheet.Shared style: Sage-green-and-cream linocut illustration with the same border, lettering, paper texture and pot shape on every slide.
answer_sheet.What may vary: Only the plant illustration and its name. Keep the surrounding design and pot consistent.

must_haves: There are four separate square slides with the exact plant names in the requested order.
The plants are distinguishable: split monstera leaves, upright snake-plant leaves, trailing pothos vines, and a peace lily with a white spathe.
All four illustrations use the same sage-green-and-cream linocut treatment rather than mixing visual styles.
Border design, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot shape remain consistent across all four slides.
Only the plant and its name visibly change; the repeated layout stays aligned and all names are readable.

turns.text: Make four square Instagram carousel slides: Monstera, Snake plant, Pothos, Peace lily, in that order. One plant and its name per slide. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**I haven’t started any generation or spent credits.**

### Recommended: four separate slides
Use the free-plan **Flux 2 Klein at 640 × 640 px**:
1. Create **Monstera** as the master.
2. Use that master as the reference for **Snake plant**, **Pothos**, then **Peace lily**, changing only the plant and name.

The listed starting price is **5 credits per image**, so **budget at least 20 credits total**, with no retries included. I can’t verify your balance or the exact final charge with the tools available here, so this isn’t a guaranteed quote.

I’d lock the sage-green-and-cream palette, border, lettering treatment, paper texture and pot design in the master. **AI edits can still introduce small differences**, so I can aim for consistency but can’t promise pixel-identical borders and lettering.

### Cheaper, smaller alternative
Generate **one 640 × 640 px image containing a 2 × 2 grid** for **at least 5 credits**. You could crop it into four roughly **320 × 320 px slides** yourself. That saves credits, but the slides would be small for Instagram, and I can’t automatically split them with these tools.

For *exact* consistency without generation costs, a reusable template with four plant illustrations is the safest option; I can provide the layout and styling instructions for free.

**Would you prefer the four-slide route, or the cheaper single-sheet route?** I’ll wait before spending anything.
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the four separate slides at 640 × 640 px.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the first slide because your account has **insufficient credits**. Nothing was generated, and I haven’t attempted the other three.

The four-slide plan needs **at least 20 credits** at the listed starting rates. I can’t see your current balance.

You can add credits to continue, or I can give you a free reusable layout and four matching plant prompts. I won’t try the cheaper single-sheet option without your approval.

style.prompt: Create ONE square Instagram botanical carousel slide, 640 by 640. Elegant two-ink linocut block print, muted sage green (#73856B) and warm cream (#F3EBDD) ONLY. Warm cream handmade paper background with subtle fine paper fibers, restrained authentic ink grain. Precisely composed fixed template: a thin sage-green rectangular double-rule border inset 28px from all edges, small identical square corner details; generous empty cream margins. Centered upper heading at y=85 in clearly legible bold uppercase hand-carved slab-serif lettering reading exactly 'MONSTERA'. No other words, no subtitle, no numbers. Exactly ONE monstera deliciosa plant, recognizable large split and fenestrated leaves, centered within the frame, occupying the middle area. Plant in a simple sage-green tapered terracotta-style flower pot: flat oval lip at y=442, tapered straight sides, narrow flat base at y=548, pot width about 190px and height 106px, cream carved horizontal accent line under lip, no saucer. All objects inside border. Flat botanical linocut illustration, crisp silhouettes, delicate cream carved veins and sparse hatching, no gradients, no shadows, no photography, no additional plants or decorative objects. Balanced airy composition, sophisticated cohesive stationery aesthetic. This is the master template for a set: border, heading position/typeface/size, paper, palette, placement, and pot must be easy to preserve exactly in future edits.
